get.description: Requires `appointments.read`. Lists appointments in the selected branch. Requires `branches.manage` when the selected branch differs from the branch in the access token. Includes minimal patient, practitioner and service summaries and caller-specific allowed actions. Search matches patient name, tenant patient number or reason. Period bounds use half-open overlap; one-sided bounds are supported. Results are ordered by start time then UID, with complete filtered pagination totals.
Requires `appointments.read`. Returns appointment availability in the selected branch. Requires `branches.manage` when the selected branch differs from the branch in the access token.

Requires `appointments.read`. Returns minimal appointment-booking context for the selected branch. Requires `branches.manage` when the selected branch differs from the branch in the access token. Does not grant branch-directory or branch-administration access.

Requires `appointments.read`. Returns branch-local daily status counts and next expected arrival, using patient, practitioner, service and search filters across all matching appointments. Requires `branches.manage` when the selected branch differs from the branch in the access token. Does not accept status filters or pagination. Requires a configured branch timezone.
Requires `appointments.read`. Returns an appointment in the selected branch. Requires `branches.manage` when the selected branch differs from the branch in the access token.

Requires `appointments.update` and `encounters.create`. Starts an encounter linked to the appointment. Requires `branches.manage` when the selected branch differs from the branch in the access token.
